item.title: Cabo Delgado, Mozambique: the situation
item.description:
Militant Islamist groups in Cabo Delgado continue to attack civilians and clash with Mozambican security forces, while a recent hostage situation ended with militants freeing captured fishermen. A blogger was killed while livestreaming an expose of chromium pollution on a Mozambican road. Mozambique has opened a diplomatic push for dual nationality rights in Tanzania, and ExxonMobil has increased its stake and consolidated control of the Rovuma LNG project through a swap with Eni. The insurgency caused 151 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
